items.meta_title: Install VpnHood! SERVER on Linux, Docker or Windows | VpnHood!
items.meta_description: Choose how to install VpnHood! SERVER: on Linux, the recommended system, in Docker or on Windows. One command does it on each, or add the server from VpnHood! MANAGER.
items.title: Install VpnHood! SERVER
items.lead: Choose the system your server will run on. A managed server is added from VpnHood! MANAGER; for a standalone one, the pages below install it with one command.
items.linux_desc: The server runs as a service, and only here does it handle IPv6 as it does IPv4.
items.docker_desc: The server runs in a container on any Linux machine with Docker, as a proxy only.
items.windows_desc: The server runs on Windows 10, Windows 11 or Windows Server, on x64. IPv6 goes through its proxy.
